---
title: "Projects"
---

## Time-Series Analytics for Smart Manufacturing

This project develops data-driven methods for extracting operational insight from manufacturing time-series data. The work focuses on forecasting, classification, pattern recognition, anomaly detection, and model evaluation in smart manufacturing environments.

**Methods:** machine learning, deep learning, time-series forecasting, time-series classification, benchmark experiments, manufacturing data analytics.

**Contribution:** built and evaluated analytics workflows that help connect high-frequency manufacturing data with process monitoring, predictive maintenance, and quality improvement.

**Related outputs:** publications on time-series forecasting, classification, high-resolution classification, and pattern recognition in smart manufacturing systems.

## Manufacturing Time-Series Analytics in NSF-Funded Research

This work contributed to NSF-funded research on manufacturing analytics at West Virginia University. The project emphasized rigorous experimental evaluation of algorithms for manufacturing time-series data and practical guidance for selecting methods in smart manufacturing applications.

**Methods:** benchmark design, experimental evaluation, manufacturing datasets, statistical and machine learning models, deep learning architectures.

**Contribution:** led the manufacturing time-series analytics task and helped define how forecasting and classification algorithms can be assessed for industrial use cases.

**Related outputs:** journal publications in Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing, Journal of Manufacturing Systems, and Manufacturing Letters.

## Real-Time Defect Detection in Robotic Assembly

This project applies machine learning to real-time defect detection and classification in robotic assembly lines. The goal is to connect sensor-rich robotic assembly data with fast quality assessment and actionable process feedback.

**Methods:** supervised machine learning, feature extraction, classification, real-time monitoring, robotic assembly data analysis.

**Contribution:** contributed to an ML framework for detecting and classifying defects during robotic assembly operations.

**Related output:** *Real-time defect detection and classification in robotic assembly lines: A machine learning framework.*

## Federated Learning and Blockchain for Smart Manufacturing

This project explores secure collaborative AI for manufacturing systems where organizations may need to learn from distributed data without exposing sensitive operational information.

**Methods:** federated learning, blockchain, deep learning for time-series forecasting, privacy-preserving analytics, collaborative manufacturing systems.

**Contribution:** investigates how federated learning and blockchain can support trustworthy model training and coordination across distributed manufacturing partners.

**Related outputs:** publications on federated learning for smart manufacturing and blockchain-empowered federated learning applications.

## Rocket Assembly Line Testbed as a Service

This project studies data acquisition strategies and testbed-as-a-service models for rocket assembly lines. The work supports repeatable experimentation, data collection, and analytics development for complex manufacturing systems.

**Methods:** testbed design, data acquisition, manufacturing systems engineering, experimental infrastructure, assembly-line analytics.

**Contribution:** contributed to the comparison of data acquisition strategies and the design of a testbed-as-a-service framework for manufacturing analytics research.

**Related output:** *Rocket assembly line testbed as a service (TaaS): A comparison of data acquisition strategies.*

## Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems in Smart Manufacturing

This project investigates how agentic AI and multi-agent systems can support decision-making in smart manufacturing. The work focuses on coordinating autonomous or semi-autonomous agents for diagnosis, planning, maintenance, and system-level decision support.

**Methods:** agentic AI, multi-agent systems, industrial AI, smart manufacturing decision support.

**Contribution:** frames the role of agent-based intelligence in manufacturing systems and identifies opportunities for hybrid human-AI and multi-agent workflows.

**Related output:** *Hybrid agentic AI and multi-agent systems in smart manufacturing.*

## Digital Twin Enabled Robot Collision Detection

This project connects digital twins, robot monitoring, and time-series forecasting to detect and anticipate collision-related behavior in robotic systems.

**Methods:** digital twins, robot analytics, time-series forecasting, collision detection, predictive monitoring.

**Contribution:** contributed to a digital twin enabled approach for robot collision detection using time-series forecasting methods.

**Related output:** *Digital twin enabled robot collision detection using time series forecasting.*
